reference_format.note: YY/5NNNNN/TYPE. Maidstone and Swale share this install and one number series, so the reference does not show which council an application belongs to.

quirks.summary: One Idox install (Mid Kent) serves Maidstone and Swale, and their references share one format and number series.
quirks.detail: A received-date search for 1-7 August 2026 returned Maidstone and Swale addresses interleaved, with nothing in the reference to tell them apart. The advanced search's ward and parish lists carry council prefixes (M for Maidstone, S for Swale).
quirks.workaround: To restrict a search to one council, filter by its ward or parish codes. Check the address before treating a result as Swale's.

quirks.summary: The committee system was not confirmed: democracy.swale.gov.uk timed out on both the Modern.gov web service and a committee page on 2026-09-26.
quirks.workaround: Find the committee system from the council's meetings page before recording a committee report as missing.

pacing.note: Nine requests at 5-6 s spacing on 2026-09-26 with no 429 or challenge.

shared_portal.note: Attribute by the ward or parish code prefix (M = Maidstone, S = Swale) or by address, not by reference.

verification.note: Portal resolved from PlanIt's 'Mid Kent' areas record and fingerprinted as Idox (Maidstone and Swale logos on the skin). Advanced search by received date 1-7 August 2026, then on a fresh session the documents tab for 26/503037/FULL (a Swale address, Norton) -> 11 file links -> downloaded one file with session and Referer: application/pdf, %PDF-1.7 magic bytes. The committee host timed out twice, so committee papers were not recorded. Content check on a full download: 533,165 bytes, 1 page with extractable text, no rate-limit, permission or unavailable notice.
